The problem

Agents that agree are not agents that are right.

Each summary or handoff re-encodes a reading: the words survive, the referent does not. This is referential drift.

Pre-registered compaction study, Gemma-4-12B and Qwen2.5-7B on one host.
The idea
Name each satellite observation by the hash of its bytes. Pass the name, not a sentence about it.
writerSentinel-2 pixel→record: cell, band, time, value→BLAKE3→emem:fact:…
receiverresolve→re-hash→compare→re-read the pixel
Names move
“the north field” drifts; a 64-bit cell id of about 10 m does not.
Values move
0.4709 becomes “about 0.47”; a fact_cid breaks if one bit changes.
1One address, every satelliteOne 10 m cell in central Berlin, read live on 30 Sep 2026: 15 products, 16 signed facts, 4 of them signed absences.

How emem encodes a memory

A fact is keyed by cell, band and valid time, written as canonical CBOR, named by BLAKE3 and signed with Ed25519. Its provenance class tells a verifier how far it can check.

Why the strike. An embedding is a model output: only its checkpoint vouches for it, and a new encoder moves every vector. emem still resolves every vector it signed, and builds on what can be re-read.

2Seventeen ways to corrupt one readingAgent B receives the Keylong NDVI record after one corruption. A deterministic verifier, no model in the loop, decides whether B acts.
Prose and JSON pass all 15 corruptions they can carry. With every check, none of the 16 in-scope cases gets through; offline, in under 2 ms.
M15 happened in production. The reader took the pixel 10 m south in 162 of 200 sampled records. Only re-reading the source caught it.

Memory on two clocks

Bengaluru: 918.0 m from the 90 m Copernicus DEM in May, 915.07 m from the 30 m COG since 11 Aug. Nothing was overwritten; asked “as of 15 Jun”, emem still answers 918.0, and both answers verify.

3Earth observation an agent can citeAll 780 facts behind sections 1 and 3 were re-hashed, signature-checked and found in the log on 30 Sep 2026.

Two seasons, three satellites, one field

Keylong, Lahaul (India): 141 Sentinel-2 L2A NDVI facts at one 10 m cell, Jan 2025 to Sep 2026. Circled: the record corrupted in section 2.

A deforestation check an auditor can re-run

Rondônia (Brazil): 100 cells 740 m apart, 600 facts from Hansen GFC, JRC GFC2020 and TMF, ESA CCI Biomass, Sentinel-2. Flag: forest in 2020, loss after the EUDR cut-off.
4Satellites that prove what they ranSAT-042, the reference spacecraft pass in emem's code, run on 30 Sep 2026.

Open archives enter emem by recomputation. A device cannot be recomputed, so its profile demands a signed OS execution trace: eight layers for orbital.satellite.v1, with every payload digest bound inside.

A write with no trace, and a fact the trace never emitted, are refused. Rewrite one log segment and the verifier names the broken link.

A trace proves what ran, not that the sensor was right. An open-archive anchor scores each claim.

the entityout of scopea shared label (M17)

Objections, answered

A signature does not make a value true.
Agreed. It fixes which bytes were served. Truth is tested by re-reading the pixel; accuracy is the product's own validation.
Why not STAC, openEO or C2PA?
They find files, run processes, sign media. emem names the one observation an agent cites, so each of them can check it.
Is a satellite writing to emem today?
No spacecraft is enrolled. The trace verifier is live on emem.dev; SAT-042 exercises every refusal.
